svg.text: CONNECTED OBSERVATIONS · BF16 CHECKPOINT · UNFUSED EXECUTION
Follow the changed condition through the computation.
Each trail shows one actual recorded pair at its first output decision. Every pair differs in one prompt token.
A = after attention addition · F = after feed-forward addition · E = layer exit. Shading marks F14.
Y: relative state separation, normalized to A12 for each pair. Legend counts: F14 fall + F15 rise / eligible decisions.
These are viewing measures of connected states, not discovered capability coordinates. Cases and positions are related.
